title.en: 3.1 Radial feeder OC and earth-fault protection
title.gu: 3.1 Radial Feeder OC તથા Earth-fault Protection

h.en: Radial feeder OC and earth-fault protection
h.gu: Radial Feeder OC તથા Earth-fault Protection

body.en:
Definition

Radial feeder protection selects the section of a normally single-ended supply path that should be disconnected for a fault while preserving healthy upstream service where possible.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Phase CT s/CBCT→OC/EF relay→local trip circuit→feeder CB; independent upstream protection provides backup.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Phase OC responds to phase current; residual EF measures Ia+Ib+Ic=3I 0 or a core-balance CT s ign al.Residual can be distorted by CT mismatch/saturation.
  • The downstream breaker nearest the fault is normally primary; upstream relay provides graded backup.The actual fault path changes with embedded generation or normally open ties.
  • EF pickup depends on neutral earthing, minimum ground-fault current, unbalance and sensor errors; not simply a fixed percentage of phase pickup.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Radial feeder protection normally single-ended path માં faulty section select કરે અને શક્યત્યાં healthy upstream service જાળવે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. CT/CBCT→OC-EF→trip→CB; upstream backup અલગ.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Phase OC phase current; residual EFI a+Ib+Ic=3I 0/CB CT s ign al; CT errorsresidual બગાડીશકે.
  • Fault નીનજીક downstream primary/upstream backup; DER/tie થી path બદલે.
  • EF pickup neutral earthing, min fault/unbalance/errors પર; phase pickup નું universal percent નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Discrimination is the coordinated separation of protection operating regions or times so the intended device clears a fault before unnecessary healthy circuits disconnect.

Classification / scope

  • Current discrimination; time discrimination; combined current–time; unit/directional schemes may be needed where these cannot satisfy speed/selectivity.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Current grading relies on fault-current variation along impedance; it can fail when minimum/maximum fault ranges overlap.
  • Time grading uses increasing upstream delays and may slow near-source clearance; current–time grading combines pickup and inverse/definite curves to improve selectivity.
  • Coordination interval includes downstream breaker clearing, relay overshoot/errors, safety margin and communication logic where relevant; no universal 0.3 svalue fits all relays.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Discrimination operating regions/times coordinate કરી intended device નેપહેલાં fault clear કરાવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Current, time, current–time; limits માં unit/directional schemes જોઈએ.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Current grading line impedance થી Ivariation વાપરે; fault-ranges overlap માં fail થઈશકે.
  • Time grading upstream delay વધારે/source clearance slow; current–time બંને combine કરે.
  • Interval માં downstream CB, overshoot/errors, margin/comms; universal 0.3s નહીં.

title.en: 3.3 ID MT setting work flow: pickup, PSM, TMS
title.gu: 3.3 IDMT Setting Work flow: Pickup, PSM, TMS

h.en: ID MT setting work flow: pickup, PSM, TMS
h.gu: IDMT Setting Work flow: Pickup, PSM, TMS

body.en:
Definition

An ID MT setting study selects a pickup that distinguishes permitted load from faults and a time multiplier that coordinates the specified inverse curve across credible system conditions.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Gather topology, max load/inrush, min/max phase/EF faults, CT data, breaker clearing and adjacent curves; begin with the furthest downstream device.
  • Select pickup above permitted load yet below minimum detectable fault with margin; then calculate PSM for each relay at the same fault case.
  • Choose the curve/TMS, check upstream interval at multiple currents, instantaneous overreach, motor start, inrush, CT s atu ration and alternate sources.Then independently review/test.
  • Example settings below are calculated classroom values, not approved utility settings or manufacturer tolerances.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Use t=0.14 TMS/(M^0.02−1), M=Isec/Ipickup>1.Solve TMS=t(M^0.02−1)/0.14.
  2. Do not divide primary fault current by secondary pickup without converting CT scale.M≤1 does not have an operating time in this model.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

ID MT study permitted load/fault વચ્ચે pickup પસંદકરી credible conditions માં chosen inverse curve ને TMS થી coordinate કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Topology, maxload/inrush, min-max fault, CT/CB/curves મેળવો; દૂરના downstream થીશરૂ.
  • Pickup allowed load ઉપર/min fault નીચે margin થી; એક fault case માંદર relay PSM અલગગણો.
  • Curve/TMS પછી multiple Igrading, instantaneous, start, inrush, saturation/alternate source check-review-test.
  • નીચેના settings classroom calc છે, approved utility settings/tolerances નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. t=0.14 TMS/(M^0.02−1), M=Isec/Ipickup>1; TMS=t(M^0.02−1)/0.14.
  2. CT scale વિના primary I/secondary pickup નહીં; M≤1 માંઆ model trip time નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A coordination calculation compares the downstream and upstream relays for the same fault, using their own CT s caled currents and the declared grading interval.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Assume a 2000 Afar-end fault.Downstream CT 200/1A, pickup 1A, TMS 0.1; upstream CT 400/1A, pickup 1A.Both use the stated IEC standard-inverse curve.
  • Use an illustrative total coordination requirement 0.35 sfor this classroom case.It is not a recommended margin for all installations.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Downstream Isec=2000/200=10A, M=10; td≈0.2971s.
  2. Upstream Isec=2000/400=5A, M=5; required tu≥0.6471s.
  3. TMS u≥0.6471(5^0.02−1)/0.14≈0.1512.Select illustrative 0.16; tu≈0.6848s, interval≈0.3877s.
  4. Recheck minimum fault, other fault locations, max load, start/inrush and instantaneous stages; one successful point does not prove full coordination.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Coordination માં same fault માટેદર relay ના CT s caled I/declared interval થી downstream-upstream compare થાય છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Far fault 2000A; down CT 200/1A, pickup 1A, TMS 0.1/up CT 400/1A, pickup 1A; બંને stated IEC curve.
  • Illustrative coordination 0.35s આ case માટે; બધી installation માટે recommendation નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Down Is ec 2000/200=10A/M 10/td≈0.2971s.
  2. Up Isec 2000/400=5A/M 5/tu≥0.6471s.
  3. TMS u≥0.6471(5^0.02−1)/0.14≈0.1512; illustrative 0.16 થી tu≈0.6848s/interval≈0.3877s.
  4. Min fault, બીજાં locations, maxload/inrush/instantaneous ફરી check; એક point પૂરતુંનહીં.

title.en: 3.4 Parallel feeder: why directional OC/EF is needed
title.gu: 3.4 Parallel Feeder: Directional OC/EF ની જરૂર

h.en: Parallel feeder: why directional OC/EF is needed
h.gu: Parallel Feeder: Directional OC/EF ની જરૂર

body.en:
Definition

Parallel-feeder protection distinguishes a faulted parallel path from healthy paths whose current may reverse or feed the fault through a remote common bus.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • For two feeders between buses, a fault on one can be fed through both sending bus and the healthy feeder into the receiving bus.Non-directional elements alone may trip both.
  • Directional OC and EF at the required terminals use declared forward reference and compatible polarisation; selective timing/current logic then trips intended boundaries.
  • Ground-current direction depends on zero-sequence network and transformer neutrals; real-power flow alone is not a valid EF direction rule.
  • Check loss of voltage, weak infeed, one feeder out and DG backfeed; do not reverse a directional setting simply to silence an unwanted trip.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Parallel feeder protection faulty path ને healthy reverse/remote-busfeed થીઅલગઓળખે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Two buses/parallel feeders માં fault ને sending તથા healthy feeder/receiving bus થી feed મળે; non-directional બંને trip કરી શકે.
  • Required terminals પર declared forward/polarisation વાળાં OC/EF; પછી selective timing થી boundaries trip.
  • Ground direction zero-sequence/neutral પર; માત્ર real power EF direction નથી.
  • Voltage-loss, weak in feed, feeder out/DG check; unwanted trip છુપાવવા direction reverse નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An overcurrent application problem occurs when measurement, settings, topology or fault behaviour invalidates the assumptions that distinguish normal load from a selective fault response.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • High-resistance faults/IBR limited current can stay below pickup; load growth/motor start/inrush can exceed it.CT s atu ration may delay or distort detection.
  • Wrong CT scale, curve family, TMS units, polarity or timer reset creates errors even when a screen displays a plausible number.
  • Topology changes, multiple sources and communication failures may require setting groups or different principles; raising pickup indiscriminately can lose sensitivity.
  • Investigate oscillography, SOE, time sync, raw test currents and breaker response; separate model error, configuration error and real equipment failure.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

OC problem માં measurement, settings, topology/fault behaviour થી normal-fault selectivity ની assumptions ખોટીપડે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • High R/IBR low Ibelow pickup; load/start/inrush above pickup; CT s atu ration detection બગાડે.
  • Wrong CT s cale, curve, TMS units, polarity/reset થી errors; plausible screen પૂરતુંનહીં.
  • Topology/multi source/comms માં groups/અલગ principle; pickup blindly વધારવાથી sensitivity ઘટે.
  • Oscillography, SOE/time/raw I/CB જોવો; model/config/hardware failure અલગકરો.

title.en: 3.6 Distance protection: reach, loops and CT/VT conversion
title.gu: 3.6 Distance Protection: Reach, Loops તથા CT/VT Conversion

h.en: Distance protection: reach, loops and CT/VT conversion
h.gu: Distance Protection: Reach, Loops તથા CT/VT Conversion

body.en:
Definition

Distance protection estimates fault-loop impedance and applies reach/time zones appropriate to the line and source conditions.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Phase–phase loop uses a consistent line voltage divided by current difference; ground loop needs residual compensation and correct zero/positive-sequence data.
  • With residual Ir=Ia+Ib+Ic, k 0=(Z0−Z1)/(3Z 1), one convention is ZAG=Va/(Ia+k 0 Ir).Other relay definitions of k 0 must not be interchanged.
  • Primary/secondary bases must be consistent; line voltage ratio and CT current ratio convert the measured impedance.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Vs=Vp/KVT, Is=Ip/KCT; therefore Zs=(KCT/KVT)Zp.
  2. For CT 600/1 Aand VT 66k V/110V, KCT=KVT=600, so secondary ohms equal primary ohms in this declared loop convention.
  3. For 50 km, z 1=0.2+j 0.4Ω/km, Zline=10+j 20Ω.An illustrative 80%Zone 1 reach is 8+j 16Ωbefore error/coverage review.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Distance protection fault-loop Zestimate કરી line/source મુજબ reach/timezones લાગુકરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Phase–phase loop માં consistentline V/current difference; ground માં residual compensation/sequence data.
  • Ir=Ia+Ib+Ic/k 0=(Z0−Z1)/(3Z 1)માં ZAG=Va/(Ia+k 0 Ir); બીજાં k 0 definitions mix નહીં.
  • Primary/secondary bases consistent રાખો; VT/CT ratios Zconvert કરે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Vs=Vp/KVT/Is=Ip/KCT થી Zs=(KCT/KVT)Zp.
  2. CT 600/1A/VT 66k V/110V માં KCT=KVT 600 થી declared loop માં Zsecondary=Zprimary.
  3. 50 km/z 1=0.2+j 0.4Ω/km થી Zline 10+j 20Ω; illustrative 80%Z1 reach 8+j 16Ω, error-review પહેલાં.

body.en:
Definition

Stepped distance protection coordinates increasing reach with time delay so a local fast zone covers a conservative line portion and delayed zones provide remote coverage/backup.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Illustrative Zone 1 may under reach the remote bus; Zone 2 extends beyond the line with delay; Zone 3 offers wider delayed backup.Coverage/timing are study results, not universal 80/120/200%rules.
  • Fault arc resistance can shift apparent R; remote infeed/outfeed changes measured impedance; load encroachment/power swings can enter a reach region without an internal short.
  • CT/CVT transient error, mutual coupling, series compensation, weak polarisation and IBR control affect dependability/security.Scheme-specific blinders, supervision and communication may be required.
  • Test inside/outside and boundary points at multiple angles, resistance, fault types and operating states; one successful V/Iinjection is not a full line-protection validation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Stepped distance વધતાં reach સાથે delay coordinate કરે; fast local conservative portion/delayed remote backup આપે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Illustrative Z1 remote નીપહેલાં/Z2 આગળ delayed/Z 3 wider backup; 80/120/200%universal નથી.
  • Arc R, remote in feed/outfeed, Z નેબદલે; load/swing fault વિના region માંઆવીશકે.
  • CT/CVT transient, mutual coupling, series C, weak polarisation/IBR થી performance બદલે; blinders/supervision/comms જોઈએ.
  • Multiple angles, R, fault/state માં inside/outside/boundary test; એક V/It est full validation નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A pilot scheme exchanges end information to distinguish an internal line fault from external or load current and coordinate high-speed end tripping.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Pilot-wire differential uses metallic pilot paths to compare end quantities; wire resistance, capacitance, induced voltage and isolation limit practical length/application.
  • Carrier-current schemes use PLCC or other communication media for permissive/blocking/direct-transfer logic.The communications channel does not itself measure the fault current.
  • PLCC uses coupling/CVT, LMU, line trap and terminal; trap has low power-frequency and high selected carrier-band impedance.Channel loss must have a defined safe fallback.
  • For permissive logic, a missing signal may delay dependability; for blocking, missing block can threaten security.Design/test echo, weak infeed, latency and channel supervision explicitly.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pilot scheme end information exchange કરી internal/external fault અલગકરે અને end trips coordinate કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Pilot-wire differential metallic path; R, C, induced V/isolation length/application limit કરે.
  • Carrier/PLCC commspermissive/blocking/transfer logic માટે; channel પોતેફ aultcurrent માપતું નથી.
  • PLCC coupling/CVT, LMU, trap/terminal; traplowpowerf/highcarrier Z; channel loss fallback જોઈએ.
  • Permissive loss થી delay/blocking loss થી security risk; echo, weak in feed, latency/supervision test કરો.

title.gu: 3.8 11k V, 66k V, 400k V Line Schemes: Power/Control/Specifications

h.gu: 11k V, 66k V, 400k V Line Schemes: Power/Control/Specifications

body.en:
Definition

A line-protection specification links the primary bay, measurement sources, relay elements, trip paths and equipment duties into a documented coordinated scheme.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Illustrative 11k V radial feeder: 12k Vclass, 630 Acontinuous, 25k A breaking candidate, CT 400/1A, VT 11k V/110 Vline-line; OC/EF main with upstream backup.
  • Illustrative 66k Vline: 72.5k Vclass, 1250A, 31.5k A candidate, CT 600/1A, VT 66k V/110V; distance/directional OC-EF and backup per study.
  • Illustrative 400k Vline: 420k Vclass, 3150A, 50k A candidate, CT 2000/1A, CVT 400k V/110V; independent main schemes such as distance+line differential/pilot, breaker failure and auto reclose where approved.
  • Conceptual primary path: line→DS/CT/CB→bus; VT/CVT and LA are shunt branches.Control: CT/VT→relay→isolated trip contact→DC trip coil→CB feedback.
  • Example utility trip DC 110 Vfor 11/66k Vand 220 Vfor 400k Vis a declared specification, not a universal rule.Students use a 24 Vmock; all candidate k A/insulation/TRV ratings require actual fault/coordination studies.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Line protection spec primary bay, measurements, relay, trip/equipment duties ને coordinated document માંજોડે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Illustrative 11k V radial: 12k Vclass/630A/25k A candidate/CT 400/1A/VT 11k V/110 Vline-line; OC-EF/upstream backup.
  • Illustrative 66k V: 72.5k Vclass/1250A/31.5k A/CT 600/1A/VT 66k V/110V; distance/directional/backup study મુજબ.
  • Illustrative 400k V: 420k Vclass/3150A/50k A/CT 2000/1A/CVT 400k V/110V; independentmains/differential-pilot/BF/approved auto reclose.
  • Primary line→DS/CT/CB→bus; VT/CVT-LA shunt.Control CT/VT→relay→trip contact→DC coil→feedback.
  • Example utility DC 110V 11/66k V/220V 400k V declared છે, universal નહીં; student 24 Vmock જ; candidate k A/insulation/TRV actualstudy થી.

body.en:
Definition

Renewable-source fault behaviour depends on generator type, converter control, current limits and grid-connection configuration, not on the word renewable alone.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Synchronous hydro can provide machine-like sub transient current; induction/DFIG wind and full-converter wind/PV have different responses controlled by hardware and firmware.
  • IBR fault current may be tightly limited and its angle/negative-sequence injection controller-dependent; there is no universal 1.2 purule or guaranteed synchronous-machine phasor response.
  • Bidirectional flow, weak infeed, is landing, changing fault levels and earth-return paths can invalidate OC, directional and distance assumptions.
  • Use validated plant/OEM models, min/max scenarios, appropriate unit/communications-based schemes and supervised setting groups.Ride-through and anti-is landing requirements must coordinate with safety/protection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Renewable fault behaviour generator/converter control, current limits/grid connection પરઆધારિત છે, માત્ર renewable શબ્દપરનહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Synchronous hydro machine-like current/induction-DFIG/full converter wind-PV જુદાં responses આપે.
  • IBR currentlimited/angle-negative-sequence controller-dependent; universal 1.2 pu/synchronous response નહીં.
  • Bidirectional, weak in feed, is landing, fault levels/earth paths થી OC/direction/distance assumptions બદલે.
  • Validated OEM models/scenarios, unit-comms/supervised groups લો; ride-through/anti-is landing protection સાથે coordinate કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Lightning protection combines shielding, surge limitation, bonding and insulation coordination to reduce the probability and consequences of direct/induced transient overvoltage s.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Shield wires/masts intercept selected direct strokes; surge arrest ers limit travelling-wave voltage locally; short low-impedance leads and a designed earth/bonding system limit added voltage.
  • An arrest er is a shunt nonlinear device, not a series fault breaker.Selection needs continuous voltage, TOV, energy/charge and protective level coordinated with equipment withstand.
  • Good measured earth resistance alone does not prove safe touch/step potential or complete lightning performance; geometry, current distribution and insulation coordination also matter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Lightning protection shielding, surge limit, bonding/insulation coordination થી direct/induced overvoltage નું risk ઘટાડે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Shield wire/mast dire cts trokeintercept/LA travelling wave locally limit; short leads/earth-bondingadded V ઘટાડે.
  • LA s hunt nonlinear device છે, series breaker નહીં; continuous V, TOV, energy/protective level coordinate.
  • Lowearth R થી touch-step/lightning performance proof નહીં; geometry/current/insulation પણ જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed supervised performance guide, not a claim that a test, reading, date or instructor signature has been completed.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Two isolated relay/test channels or offline ID MT model, CT ratios, feeder SLD and timing sheet.
  2. Model downstream/upstream for the same primary fault; convert each CT current separately and block actual trip coils.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Read the actual device manual, ratings, settings and approved safe plan; identify energy sources, trip destinations and all blocked/isolation boundaries.
  2. Power OFF: check instrument ranges, polarity, burdens, CT test blocks, grounding and output isolation; no interlock/protection bypass.
  3. Calculate pickup, PSM, TMS and required interval; test downstream then upstream using the same fault case.
  4. Repeat at several fault levels and permitted load/start points; record minimum achieved margin rather than one favourable point.
  5. Write actual readings with units, test conditions, quality and evidence only after genuine performance; computed traces stay in separate labelled columns.
  6. Return settings/links to the documented authorised state, isolate/discharge, and close the instructor checklist without inventing observations.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Official practical 6; source Unit/CO 3; 2 suggested hours.No individual compulsory star is marked.
  • Use offline models or approved isolated secondary injection under qualified supervision; 24 VDC mock construction does not authorise high-energy relay/CT/VT tests.Source variac is not isolation.

Worked example / setting interpretation

  1. 2000 Afault: CT 200/1 down, TMS 0.1→0.2971s; CT 400/1 up, TMS 0.16→0.6848s, calculated margin 0.3877 sfor declared pickups 1A.

Reliability and safety checks

  • Wrong margin often means using the same secondary current at different CT ratios or mixing curve families; correct before changing real settings.
  • Never open a live CT s econdary, short a VT s econdary, lift protective earth or attach unsafe scope grounds.Actual switchyard operations require site authority/permit.

Blank actual observation record

Test point / settingsInjected V / I / anglePickup / time / outputEvidence / interpretation
————
————
————
————
————

Date / તારીખ: ______ Instructor / સહી: ______
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Source-listed supervised પ્રયોગમાર્ગદર્શિકા છે; test/readings/date/signature પૂર્ણથયાનો દાવો નથી.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Two isolated channels/offline ID MT, CT/SLD/timing sheet.
  2. Same fault પરબંને CTI અલગ convert/actual trip block.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Actual manual, ratings/settings/safe plan વાંચો; sources/trip destinations/isolation ઓળખો.
  2. OFF માં ranges, polarity, burden, CT blocks, earth/output isolation check; protection bypass નહીં.
  3. Pickup/PSM/TMS/interval calc; સમાન case માં down/up test.
  4. Multiple fault/load/start test; minimum actual margin record.
  5. ખરેખરપ્રયોગપછી actual readings units/conditions/evidence સાથેલખો; computed trace અલગ label માં.
  6. Settings/links authorised state માંપરત/isolate-discharge/checklist close; readings invent નહીં.

q.en: How does TMS change IEC SI time?
q.gu: TMS થી IEC SI time કેવી રીતે બદલાય?

a.en: For fixed PSM>1, time is directly proportional to TMS in t=0.14 TMS/(PSM^0.02−1).It does not change pickup and is not a guaranteed constant operating time.
a.gu: Fixed PSM>1 પર time∝TMS છે; pickup બદલાતો નથી અને time constant નથી.

q.en: Why directional relays on parallel feeders?
q.gu: Parallel feeder પર directional relay કેમ?

a.en: Ahealthy parallel path can feed a fault through the common remote bus.Non directional pickup may trip healthy and faulty paths; directional end supervision improves selectivity when its polarisation/current assumptions hold.
a.gu: Healthy parallel path remote bus થી fault feed કરી શકે; non-directional healthy path પણ trip કરે; proper polarisation સાથે directional selection સુધરે.

a.en: No.It is an illustrative under reach choice.Actual reach depends on impedance error, CT/CVT transients, infeed, mutual coupling, source impedance and scheme studies; some applications reduce or disable fast under reach.
a.gu: નહીં; illustrative under reach છે.Actual reach errors, transients, infeed/coupling/SIR/study થી નક્કી થાય; કેટલાકમાં reduce/disable કરાય.

q.en: What is the secondary impedance conversion?

a.en: With KCT=Ip/Isand KVT=Vp/Vs, Zs=(KCT/KVT)Zp.Both ratios and phase/ground-loop conventions must match; inverting the ratio can cause dangerous reach error.
a.gu: KCT=Ip/Is, KVT=Vp/Vs હોય તો Zs=(KCT/KVT)Zp; ratio/loop convention મેળવો, ઉલટો ratio reach error કરે.

a.en: Pilot wire uses a dedicated metallic pilot circuit for the selected comparison scheme.Carrier uses communication such as power-line carrier for end logic; channel loss, latency and weak infeed require defined fallback.
a.gu: Pilot-wire metallic pilot circuit વાપરે; carrier end-logic communication વાપરે; loss/latency/weak-infeed માટે defined fallback જોઈએ.

q.en: Do all renewable plants give the same fault current?
q.gu: બધા renewable plants સમાન fault I આપે?

a.en: No.Machine type, converter limits, controls, earthing and connection determine magnitude, angle and sequence behaviour.Use validated OEM models and study multiple operating modes.
a.gu: નહીં.Machine/converter/control/earthing થી magnitude, angle/sequences બદલાય; validated OEM model તથા multiple modes study કરો.

q.en: Does a surge arrest er clear a sustained fault?
q.gu: Surge arrest er sustained fault clear કરે?

a.en: It limits transient voltage as a nonlinear shunt device; it is not the series fault breaker.Continuous voltage, TOV, energy and protective level must coordinate with insulation and earthing.
a.gu: તે nonlinear shunt surge limiter છે, series fault CB નથી; continuous V/TOV/energy/protective level insulation/earth સાથે coordinate કરો.
